content.name: Vardath - Living Factions and Builders
content.description: Non-hostile NPC construction requests for player XL builders, 200000-credit hiring fees, 100000Cr/h active and 25000Cr/h standby, save-persistent SETA-aware assigned-builder payroll, including transit before deployment and one-time construction completion reputation rewards. Faction economy-driven station expansion. Experimental X4 9.00; now includes Terran female white dress and Yaki-crewed Kyushu game start (Cradle of Humanity DLC required).
